wiringInterpretation.rationale: Plan_final 05-002 wires the PLAYPAL lump, the COLORMAP lump, and the canonical ST_doPaletteStuff palette-effect selector into a frozen runtime artifact built once per launch from the 05-001 IwadResourceCache. The new wrapper at src/vanilla/paletteAndColormap.ts imports parsePlaypal and parseColormap from the read-only src/assets/ parsers, finds the PLAYPAL and COLORMAP lump entries via IwadResourceCache.findLump, and exposes a selectEffectPalette(effect) helper that maps the four canonical effect kinds (normal, damage, bonus, radiation) onto palette indices [0, 13]. Gamma is intentionally deferred to plan_final 06-007 (wire-sky-detail-gamma-palette); this step exposes only the VANILLA_GAMMA_INDEX_RANGE constant so callers can validate usegamma upstream. Failure modes (missing lumps, wrong-size lumps) surface as typed PaletteAndColormapError instances with a stable PaletteAndColormapErrorReason discriminator.

crossPlanInventoryUpdate.rationale: src/vanilla/ is not declared as a source_roots entry in any plan_vanilla_parity classify-real / classify-simplified / classify-stubbed group. The plan_vanilla_parity inventory-wad-and-asset-modules.json pins importer counts (src and test) for every src/wad/ and src/assets/ module; adding the focused test for 05-002 increases test_importer_count for the three modules listed above by exactly 1 each. Updating the inventory JSON to reflect the new on-disk counts is the only way to satisfy the inventory test without abandoning the focused test. This matches the 05-001 precedent.
